summary: Frontend-only regression test of the 'Materials Hub' rebrand (teal #0E7C86 header, pill nav tabs, renamed menu labels) across all 8 pages. All checks PASSED. (1) Verified all 8 routes ('/', '/purchasing-plan', '/production-plan', '/inventory', '/purchasing-strategy/supplier-master', '/purchasing-strategy/quota-allocation', '/admin', '/admin/sap-write') render the new teal header (rgb(14,124,134) confirmed via computed style) with 'Materials Hub' title + correct page subtitle, and the current page's nav tab/dropdown-trigger shows the white active pill (bg-white text-[#0B6B74]) correctly. (2) 'Supplier Management' dropdown (nav-purchasing-strategy) correctly lists 'Supplier Master'/'Quota Allocation' and navigates on click; 'Master Data' dropdown (nav-admin) correctly lists 'Component Master'/'SAP Write' and navigates on click. (3) Clicking a top-level pill tab (tested Production Planning from Quota Allocation page) navigates correctly and the clicked tab highlights white/active post-navigation. (4) Production Planning page: 'Your name (for selection tracking)' input (actor-name-input) renders as a rounded pill matching the teal theme on the right side of header, accepts text input fine (filled 'TestUser QA', value persisted). (5) BOM Management page: connection-status-indicator pill is positioned next to the title (not far-right) and correctly cycled through 'Checking SAP...' -> 'SAP PRD Connected' states; entering Part/BOM ID 'P26584' and clicking 'Pull BOM' worked normally while the pill was visible - no blocking, returned 7 components / MAX LEVEL 2 correctly with 'Resolved: P26584_3' badge. (6) Regression sweep of Inventory, Supplier Master, Quota Allocation, Admin (Component Master), and Purchasing Plan pages all loaded cleanly with no error text, no blank pages, no visual breakage (screenshots confirm clean layout, no overlapping/low-contrast text, header not covering content).

critical_code_review_comments: NavTabs.jsx is clean and well-commented - labels renamed while routes/testIds preserved exactly as required, minimal DRY-friendly TABS/SUBTABS arrays.

No business logic touched in this branding pass, consistent with the stated purely-cosmetic scope - all 8 pages' functional flows (BOM pull, nav dropdowns, actor-name input, connection-status polling) verified unaffected.
